text: What if Earth lost all oxygen for just 5 seconds?
Think you can just hold your breath? Think again.
Second one: The daytime sky turns pitch black.
Without oxygen to scatter sunlight, it is instant midnight.
Second two: Your inner ears explode from the sudden pressure drop.
And with no ozone layer, raw UV light cooks your skin.
Second three: Every concrete skyscraper and bridge collapses into dust.
Oxygen is the chemical binder holding concrete together.
Billions of cars stall and airplanes plunge out of the sky.
Second five: The ground vanishes beneath your feet.
Earth's crust is 45% oxygen. Without it, the ground shatters into freefall.
And then, oxygen returns. Take a deep breath.
You will never take 5 seconds for granted again.
